description_en: Crassus built the largest private fortune in Rome through proscription purchases, a private fire brigade used as a real estate speculation tool, silver mines, agricultural estates, and slave trading.
Crassus commanded eight legions against the slave revolt of Spartacus, ultimately defeating him in 71 BCE.
Crassus launched a large-scale invasion of Parthia as governor of Syria. The campaign ended in catastrophic defeat at Carrhae.
Crassus held the consulship twice, both times sharing the office with Pompey.
